sections.Profile:
The "Thoro-Bred" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in February 1965, is a two-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Ed Krynski, with artwork by Roy Parker.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1965
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Sports, Horses, Original Theme, Hunting
sections.Design Team:
- Animation: Ed Krynski
- Design: Ed Krynski
- Art: Roy Parker
- Design: Wayne Neyens
